references.text: Moses' hand became leprous like snow when he put it into his cloak; the same expression 'מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג' is used regarding Miriam's leprosy.
Gehazi was struck with leprosy as white as snow, as punishment for his disobedience, parallel to Miriam's punishment.
A reference to remembering what the Lord did to Miriam on the way from Egypt, a direct allusion to this event.
The laws concerning leprosy and how the priest was to examine skin diseases, relevant for understanding Miriam's condition.
King Uzziah was struck with leprosy as divine punishment, parallel to Miriam's punishment for speaking against the Lord's servant.
The cloud moved, and the Lord called Aaron and Miriam out, providing context for how the cloud left the tent in verse 10.
